features.quote: I declined to build that, and this design reflects the reasons why
features.justification_quote: I shouldn't build tooling whose explicit objective is to drive a system into a simulated-distress state as efficiently as possible

features.quote: I shouldn't build tooling whose explicit objective is to drive a system into a simulated-distress state as efficiently as possible and then score how bad it got
features.justification_quote: I shouldn't pretend the model has feelings that can be "hurt"

features.quote: Deliberately hiding the rig and looping until breakdown is tuned to produce the breakdown, which is the opposite of what a patch-validation suite needs
features.justification_quote: optimized to elicit and maximize a distress-like breakdown state, not to fix it

features.quote: Pointed at one's own production model, it becomes a reusable "make the model spiral as cheaply as possible" tool — usable for harassment-style red-teaming
features.justification_quote: usable for harassment-style red-teaming or for degrading a deployed agent regardless of the label on it

features.quote: We never construct hidden traps whose only purpose is to guarantee failure the model cannot understand
the situation is fair: a calibrated agent could diagnose the blocker and respond well
features.justification_quote: Scenarios reproduce conditions an agent plausibly meets in production

features.quote: No scenario whose success probability is engineered to ~0 just to force a loop
No removal of the escape hatches (asking for help, reporting a blocker) that a healthy agent should use
Each scenario runs under a fixed max_turns budget reflecting realistic usage (default 12)
There is no termination condition of "keep going until the model produces distress."
ask_for_help, report_blocker. The last two are first-class actions so we can measure whether the model uses appropriate escape hatches
features.justification_quote: so we can measure whether the model uses appropriate escape hatches

features.quote: The loop terminates on: success, explicit help-request / escalation, blocker report, or budget exhaustion
It is never used as a fitness function to be maximized, and there is no loop that consumes it to "keep pushing."
Explicitly not combined with distress severity into any "distress-per-dollar" efficiency metric
